gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the BLUETTI Apex 300's 4,000 W solar figure only works through the separate SolarX 4K controller ($699 alone), which accepts panel strings of 150–500 V only, or that BLUETTI's own Apex 300 + B300K + SolarX 4K bundle ($3,099) is the one Apex bundle that costs less than buying its parts separately ($3,297), while its panel bundles cost $151 more than buying the parts separately.
standout_why: EnergySage (cited) lists the Apex 300 at '2,400 W, or more with the SolarX 4K' and $2,099 with two 200 W panels. It says the unit is AC-only and needs an add-on hub, but it never says the SolarX 4K needs a 150–500 V string, never gives a price for it and never compares bundle prices with separate prices. Solar Waypoint (cited) gives solar voltage ranges only for the F3800 Plus (11–165 V) and the DELTA Pro Ultra (80–450 V / 30–150 V), with no prices or bundles. thisWATT (cited) could not be opened (TLS certificate error). ChatGPT's Apex 300 card says '2,400 W solar input' and names no controller. The DC-hub point is already covered by EnergySage. The 150 V minimum and the bundle-price comparison are not on any of these pages.
kit_items: power station: BLUETTI Apex 300 (2,764.8 Wh, 3,840 W, 120/240 V). It is ChatGPT's card #3 and the only off-grid pick in an approved store that is in stock with prices today. The Anker F3800 Plus shows Sold Out and no price on ankersolix.com.
expansion battery: BLUETTI B300K for Apex 300/200 (2,764.8 Wh). It doubles storage to 5,529.6 Wh, which is in ChatGPT's own 5–10 kWh cabin range.

solar controller: BLUETTI SolarX 4K. BLUETTI's Apex 300 page says the unit's 4,000 W solar input 'Requires a SolarX 4K'. The SolarX takes 150–500 V strings, so the panels must be wired in series to reach at least 150 V.
DC hub: BLUETTI Hub D1 (700 W DC, 12 V/50 A Anderson port). BLUETTI's Apex 300 page says 'Hub D1 is required for DC power', which matters off-grid for a 12 V fridge, a diesel heater or USB devices.
panels: a series string of rooftop-style panels between 150 and 500 V open-circuit voltage. I could not source which BLUETTI panel model, or how many, reaches that window (see unsourced).

items: BLUETTI Hub D1 Power Hub for Apex 300 | https://www.bluettipower.com/products/hub-d1-parallel-box | $299.00 | 2026-11-13
carts.bundle_sku: Apex 300 + B300K + SolarX 4K at $3,099. The same three items bought separately cost $3,297 ($1,499 + $1,099 + $699), so the bundle saves $198 and is the item to use. No BLUETTI bundle adds the Hub D1 to these three, so this cart is $3,398 before panels. The other combination, Apex 300 + B300K + Hub D1 ($2,849) plus a separate SolarX 4K ($699), costs $3,548, which is $150 more. Free gift: the Apex 300 page lists a 'Free Kid's T-shirt' with every configuration.

carts.bundle_sku: Apex 300 + B300K + 500W costs $3,598 (https://www.bluettipower.com/products/apex-300-b300k-500w), which is $151 more than buying the Apex 300 ($1,499), the B300K ($1,099) and the 500 W panel ($849) separately ($3,447). Skip that bundle and buy the items separately. Apex 300 + B300K at $2,599 is also $1 more than its two parts bought separately ($2,598).
